Overall ranking

Successful: tasks (out of 76) whose submission passed the task grader. Task Avg: mean normalized score over all 76 tasks, with failed tasks scored 0 (used for the ranking). Domain Avg: mean of the 9 domain means. Success-only Avg: mean score over the successful tasks only.

Scoring. Official evaluator, normalized task score (0–1). Every config is averaged over all 76 tasks: a task without a valid evaluator score (timeout, no or invalid submission, agent failure) counts as 0, and any task running longer than 2 h (7,200 s) is a failure even if a submission was written. Task Avg = mean over the 76 tasks; Domain Avg = mean of the 9 domain means.
